source: BBC News; Emergency Services Times; British Transport Police press statements; BTP's own LFR Deployment Register (btp.police.uk)
notes: British Transport Police (BTP) Live Facial Recognition deployments at London rail and Underground stations. BTP is a separate force from the Metropolitan Police -- maintains its own LFR programme. Trial launched Feb 2026 at major London termini, expanded to the Underground Aug 2026, runs until Nov 2026. From 2026-09-05, deployment-level figures (watchlist size, alerts, arrests, faces scanned) are sourced from BTP's own published LFR Deployment Register, not just launch announcements -- see _review/BTP-EXTRACTION-DIFF-2026-09-05.md for what changed and why.
